findings.title: State the nonround domain explicitly for the classification tables in Theorems B and C

locations.anchor: Table1, Remark1.1 and paragraph preceding TheoremB

findings.claim: A literal reading applying TheoremsB/C and their tables to every tau>0 includes the round metric tau=1.
findings.construction: For B take n=1,tau=1 and S4=S7 intersect (R5 x {0}^3); for C take tau=1 and S8=S15 intersect (R9 x {0}^7).
findings.hypotheses: Each is connected, complete, embedded and proper, with dimension>=2. At tau=1 the metric is exactly round. For a point x and unit tangent v in the defining linear subspace, gamma(s)=cos(s)x+sin(s)v stays there and is an ambient geodesic; thus the submanifold is totally geodesic.
findings.decisive_evidence: Table1 for quaternionic n=1 has only nonempty dimensions2,3; octonionic entries have maximum dimension7. Tables2/3 are restricted to tau<1/2. Hence these great S4 and S8 cannot be congruent to any listed entry, since congruence preserves dimension.
counterevidence_considered: TheoremA, Lemmas4.1/4.2, Theorem4.4 and Theorem5.7 explicitly exclude tau=1.
Remark1.1 and p14 discuss the round case separately.
Jacobi spectral separation degenerates only at tau=1, matching the intended nonround setting.
findings.impact: Scope clarification; no demonstrated failure of the intended nonround classification. No Major or Minor asserted from this boundary example.
findings.repair_limits: State B/C for tau>0,tau!=1 and list the round great-sphere classification separately. This repairs the scope statement but does not certify the remaining classification proofs.

independent_verification.conditions: The literal all-tau reading includes tau=1; for B choose n=1, Sigma=S7 intersect(R5 x0^3), and for C Sigma=S15 intersect(R9 x0^7). These are proper connected complete embedded submanifolds of dimensions4 and8, satisfying d>=2.
independent_verification.decisive_independent_check: At tau=1 the ambient metric is round. For any unit x in the chosen linear subspace and any unit tangent v there, gamma(s)=cos(s)x+sin(s)v remains in the intersection and is a unit-speed ambient geodesic. Thus each witness is totally geodesic. Table1 has no dimension4 for quaternionic n=1 and no dimension8 for the octonionic case; Tables2/3 require tau<1/2. Congruence preserves dimension, so neither witness is represented in the literal all-parameter tables.
independent_verification.counterevidence: The immediately preceding discussion already gives the round great-sphere classification; TheoremA, Lemmas4.1–4.2, Theorem4.4 and Theorem5.7 explicitly exclude tau=1. Remark1.1 and p14 separate the round metric, and the nonround spectral argument has no other positive collision. This context supports the intended nonround reading rather than a newly proved failure of that classification.
independent_verification.impact: An explicit parameter-scope clarification is warranted. The independent examples refute only an unqualified all-positive-parameter reading; they do not establish Major or Minor defects in the intended nonround classification.
independent_verification.repair_boundary: State B/C for tau>0,tau!=1 and give the already discussed round great-sphere case separately. Completeness and connectedness imply the image is the whole corresponding great sphere through the exponential map; ambient orthogonal transformations give one image congruence class per dimension. This does not prove the remaining nonround tables or exceptional realizations.

independent_acceptance.result: Scope clarification independently confirmed for the exact arXiv v3. No Major/Minor finding established for the intended nonround claims by these checks; report TeX/PDF unchanged.
independent_acceptance.scope: Independent check of S1, all explicit parameter/completeness/dimension hypotheses, every listed dimension used by the round-sphere witnesses, metric and Jacobi normalization, spectral projection argument of Lemma4.1, the dimension implication of Corollary4.5, and the adjacent nonround/half-parameter boundaries. The remainder of the classification is not certified.

independent_analytic_reasoning: Solving J''+lambda J=0 with J(0)=0,J'(0)=w gives factors sin(2t)/2 and sin(t), whose squared ratio is cos(t)^2; the hyperbolic ratio is cosh(t)^2. This confirms the length homothety and the excluded round limit.

For a tangent vertical/horizontal unit vector, total geodesy makes the tangent space invariant under its self-adjoint Jacobi operator. With disjoint block spectra, polynomial interpolation constructs the horizontal/vertical projections as polynomials in that operator, hence both preserve the tangent space.

The only possible positive spectral collisions solve tau=1/tau, tau=1 or tau=4-3tau, all yielding1. Zero-multiplicity eigenvalues are omitted; no converse assertion that every low-dimensional block actually collides is needed.
If the tangent dimension is d>=f and the vertical dimension is f-1, dim(T intersect horizontal)>=d-(f-1)>0. The nonround splitting lemma then applies.

The compact shape eigenvalue difference is tan(t), nonzero for0<t<pi/2; the vertical eigenvalue vanishes at t=pi/4, equivalent to tau=1/2. No nondegenerate argument is silently extended across this boundary.

prior_calculations.method: Full13-line reviewer-written script and exact output read and hash-bound; not rerun. All ratios, roots, table dimensions and the great-circle ODE were independently rederived analytically.

limitations: Focused independent acceptance of S1 and the explicitly checked supporting computations, not a complete reproof of the48-page source.
Full rigidity, all polynomial eliminations in Theorem5.7, its converse integration step, projective realizations and octonionic orbit classifications remain outside the certified scope.
The exact acquired arXivv3 is the scientific object; publisher-version equivalence is not asserted.
No author code executed and no human adjudication.
